concept.subject: A great wooden ship's wheel on the deck of a sailing ship, turning slowly, between the white bulwarks with their glass windscreens, a brass spyglass behind it and rigging against a cloudy blue sky.
concept.composition: The wheel fills the middle, its hub at half the width and three fifths of the height, its double wooden rim reaching from a quarter to three quarters of the width and up to a quarter of the height, with turned handles sticking out at the upper and lower left, the upper and lower right and the top right. The brass spyglass stands behind the rim at a third of the width near the top; the bulwarks run in from both sides at half height, a windscreen along the top of each, and a long shadow crosses the deck at the lower right. Sky and clouds fill the top corners; the mast and its rigging rise behind the top center.
concept.layout: 72 round pegs and 96 bricks. The rim's inner ring is the rotating template's single wheel, its center lowered to the picture's hub: a ring of curved bricks broken into six slots, a ring of pegs and six spokes of pegs, turning slowly around a static hub peg. The rim's outer ring is three brick arcs on each side with gaps between them and a solid crown over the top that sheds balls off the turning ring under the cannon; brass studs sit outside the arcs between the handles. The handles and the spyglass are short brick bars, the windscreens, rails and planking of the bulwarks brick rows, the rivets, rigging blocks and clouds pegs.

features: Moving elements (spec 8): a turning ship's wheel

difficulty.note: Middle of the stage: the solid crown turns balls away from the top of the turning ring, where most orange pegs gather, so the wheel is reached from its sides and through the gaps in the outer ring.

background.prompt: A photo of a weathered wooden ship's wheel on the deck of a sailing ship under a blue sky with soft clouds. The wheel fills the middle: its brass hub at half the width and about three fifths of the height, its double wooden rim reaching from about a quarter to three quarters of the width and from about a quarter of the height to the bottom edge, with eight honey-colored spokes and turned handles sticking out at the upper and lower left, the upper and lower right and the top right. A brass spyglass stands behind the rim at about a third of the width near the top, and the white mast with red rigging rises behind the top center. White bulwarks run in from both sides at about half the height, each with a glass windscreen along its top and a gray rail below it; a long shadow crosses the deck at the lower right, where a dark winch handle shows at the right edge. The lower corners are plain gray deck and bulwark.

picture.title: Close-up of a ship's wooden steering wheel and throttle against clear blue sky.
picture.author: Kimani Marley
